metadata.title: docs: add PR review workflow to AGENTS.md with cycle tracker template
metadata.author: jonpspri

description:
## Summary

- Adds a **PR Review Workflow** section to `AGENTS.md` codifying the fixed-point review loop (review → fix → loop until zero blocking findings), rebase recipe with conflict-resolution policy, scope verification against linked issues, and the 6-step pre-merge validation gate.
- Introduces `todo/NOTES.template.md` as the canonical, committed review-cycle state template. Instances are copied to `todo/NOTES.md` (gitignored) per review — eliminating procedural duplication while preserving per-gate checkpoint tracking.
- Fixes a dangling clause in Commit & PR Standards and adds `todo/NOTES.md` + `todo/NOTES.template.md` exceptions to the Maintenance Guardrails ignore list.

## Files Changed

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `AGENTS.md` | New PR Review Workflow section (+47 lines), dangling-clause fix, ignore-list carve-out |
| `.gitignore` | `todo/` → `todo/*` + `!todo/NOTES.template.md` to allow tracking the template |
| `todo/NOTES.template.md` | New 17-line review-cycle state template |
| `.secrets.baseline` | Auto-updated by pre-commit (line-number sync) |

## Design Decisions

- **Single source of truth**: Procedure lives only in `AGENTS.md`; `NOTES.template.md` holds only mutable state (cycle counter, phase toggles, gate checkboxes).
- **Ephemeral instances**: `todo/NOTES.md` is gitignored and worktree-local — created per review via `cp todo/NOTES.template.md todo/NOTES.md`, discarded naturally.
- **Fixed-point loop**: Review cycles repeat until a full pass yields zero blocking findings. Each cycle addresses blocking + functionally-impacting findings; cosmetic suggestions may be deferred.
- **Scope verification**: Each cycle cross-references the PR description against linked issues to catch unstated gaps or scope drift.

commits.message:
docs: add PR review workflow to AGENTS.md with cycle tracker template

Codify the fixed-point review loop (review → fix → loop until zero blocking
findings), rebase recipe with conflict policy, scope verification against
linked issues, and the 6-step pre-merge validation gate.

Introduce todo/NOTES.template.md as the canonical, committed review-cycle
state template. Instances are copied to todo/NOTES.md (gitignored) per
review. This eliminates procedural duplication between AGENTS.md and the
old NOTES.md while keeping per-gate checkboxes for progress tracking.

Also fixes: dangling clause in Commit & PR Standards, adds todo/NOTES.md
and todo/NOTES.template.md exceptions to Maintenance Guardrails ignore list.

Signed-off-by: Jonathan Springer <jps@s390x.com>
